title: DashRoute: Food-Delivery Rider Batching
context: Delivery apps batch orders for riders, promise ETAs and decide how many riders to keep on shift.
input: Orders: id, ready time, restaurant, distance (km), bag weight; rider shifts.

milestones.title: Duplicate orders
milestones.requirement: Order ids submitted twice by app retries (count array over ids).

milestones.title: Fill a rider’s bag
milestones.requirement: Choose orders whose weights fit a 10 kg bag as fully as possible (subset sum with memo).

milestones.title: Pair short trips
milestones.requirement: Find two orders whose distances sum exactly to a rider’s planned 9 km loop: sort and two pointers.

milestones.title: Fastest 50 orders
milestones.requirement: Shortest stretch of minutes in which 50 orders arrived (variable window).

milestones.title: Minimum delivery rate
milestones.requirement: Minimum deliveries per hour so every zone’s orders finish within 6 hours (binary search on the rate).

milestones.title: Merge rider shifts
milestones.requirement: Merge overlapping shift windows to see when coverage exists.
